summary: Retested updated storefront, checkout, admin, auth lockout, and build flows. Core backend and browser flows passed; one admin product-create error-state gap remains.

minor.issue: CORS_ORIGINS remains wildcard with allow_credentials false; acceptable for current bearer-token flow but does not satisfy the documented explicit-origin credentialed-auth playbook.

integration_issues.issue: ProductAdmin add() has no catch/error state; a failed POST can leave the user with no visible feedback.

action_items: Add visible error handling around ProductAdmin product creation.
Resolve the React hook dependency warning in AdminPanel.
If cookie credentials are intended, replace wildcard CORS with explicit origins and enable credentials.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductAdmin makes an authenticated mutation without catch/failure UI, violating the required visible API error-state behavior.

success_rate.backend: 100% (4/4 regression tests; lockout and invalid-token checks passed)

seed_data_creation: No persistent test data created; existing checkout consumed one seeded unit as part of the tested order flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile storefront, detail, cart, required-email checkout, order placement, admin login/dashboard/settings, invalid token, lockout, and production build were tested. Product add failure simulation remains untested beyond code review.
rca of the issue: ProductAdmin.add awaits api.post without try/catch, unlike settings save and order status update. Rejected API promises therefore surface only through the browser runtime and do not update visible component state.
